name: anna-flooring
description: Shortcuts for running the Anna Flooring server and website from the repo root. No dependencies.

scripts.dev:ai: cd ai && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client && npm run test:ai
